Wow, way to take your passion and make it into a biz! You can make your studio work, I'm sure. And remember, I'm always here for you.", "D18:3-5:Gina:Thanks, Jon! Appreciate the kind words. Sorry to hear about the studio, but glad to see the positivity. Rome wasn't built in a day so keep pushing on!", "D3:13-4:Jon:Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. I'm passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces. Plus, I wanted to blend my love for dance and fashion, so it was a perfect match.", "D2:7-2:Gina:Definitely! Just focus on why you started this – because you love it! Have faith in yourself, Jon. I do!", "D14:5-2:Jon:Thanks for the advice, Gina! I already started doing what you said about social media and posted some of my dance videos. It's creating a bit of a stir.", "D8:8-2:Gina:Thanks! I've been dreaming of this for a while now - can't wait to see what happens! and shared a photo of a computer screen showing a book and a pair of shoes", "D15:12-2:Gina:I'll be right by your side, Jon.
